title: Implement local credential session lifecycle and session API
verify: POST /api/session/login returns safe session summary and sets HTTP-only same-site cookie by default.
POST /api/session/logout is idempotent and clears/revokes only the current session.
GET /api/session/me returns safe actor/session summary without secrets.
Internal activation primitive atomically sets first password, activates Account/Membership, and issues LocalSession for FT-003.
evidence_required: Unit/integration test output covering login, logout, expiry, revocation, disabled account, disabled membership, and no-leak errors.
Verification note for cookie/bearer transport behavior and redaction.
Red-verify semantic-pass artifact because this is T3.
Human checkpoint and rollback/recovery note required before closure because this is T3.
constraints: FT-001 must not expose the public invite activation route; FT-003 owns POST /api/local-invites/activate.
AUTH_CREDENTIAL_INVALID must not reveal whether a login exists.
No refresh-token flow in MVP; default session TTL is 7 days.
invariants: .memory-bank/tech-specs/FT-001-local-accounts-sessions-actor-context.md: missing, expired, revoked, malformed, or unknown session fails closed.
.memory-bank/invariants.md: secrets/auth material never enter logs, timeline, manifests, Bus, UI Feed, screenshots, exports, or agent context.
verification_targets: .memory-bank/tech-specs/FT-001-local-accounts-sessions-actor-context.md: Session Lifecycle, API Surface, Error Contract, and Verification.
Runtime API integration target: login/logout/me exercise LocalSession persistence through the repository boundary.
